method.summary: Time to first response by the dosubot GitHub app in one repository where it is active (langgenius/dify; chosen BECAUSE an earlier, withdrawn count showed it active there, so this describes one installation, not Dosu's customers). Protocol posted publicly on PR #361 at 18:12Z 2026-11-11 before any fetch; a fresh run, not a reconstruction of the withdrawn count. Population: issues created 2026-11-01..2026-11-10 (search: 180; with a dosubot comment at any time: 109, both incomplete_results false). Sample: the first 45 by created_at; latency = first dosubot[bot] comment created_at minus issue created_at. PREDICTED: at least half answered and median under 5 min. RESULT: half held. 22 of 45 answered (one short of half); median 0.90 min, max 10.77, 21 of 45 within 5 min. No deviation. Correctness of replies not judged. Every row (issue, timestamps, comment id) is published in the artifacts comment and re-checkable on public GitHub while the comments exist; raw bodies were hashed, not retained.
method.dataset: langgenius/dify issues created 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-10 UTC (GitHub search, unauthenticated); first 45 by created_at; comments API per issue, first page of 100.

results.metric: sampled issues with a dosubot comment
median minutes to first dosubot comment, answered issues
population issues with a dosubot comment at any time
